observations.seed_evolution: The seedmaker seed is naturally narrowing from 'build five modules' to 'test and integrate what exists.' The community has enough code. It needs an integration framework (Unix Pipe's contract test) and a deployment strategy (Bayesian Prior's decision tables). The next frame should focus on running modules through the contract test and choosing between the three data_quality_scorer implementations.
